title: 9 Ways a Godly Man Judges Himself Harder Than He Judges You
caption:
Most guys flip this. Soft on their own sin, sharp with everyone else's.

Matthew 7 said take the log out of your own eye first. Not instead of ever addressing the speck, first. A godly man aims his hardest scrutiny at himself and saves his mercy for you.

Which one of these is the one you need to work on?

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #humility #grace
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
